findingDetails.title: The advise reply uses a field the recorded pre_tool format does not carry, on a strict binding
The startup-guard spawn budget equals the inner per-script budget, so the warnings are lost on a slow start
The goal part has no kill switch and the switch table does not mention it

results.notes: The binding set matches the recorded 18 bindings. The reply format does not: the doc records one pre_tool reply and the code writes a second, unrecorded one.
No checklist document on a hook and plugin surface.

noveltyJustification: All three findings are new. R2-P2-003 is adjacent to the prior R4-P2-003--8f1aef762f06 README fix but is the part that fix still omits, so it is a distinct open gap rather than a repeat.
ruledOut: session-cleanup not disposing the plugin at session start: dispose() runs the cleanup script, which is the session-end work
spec-gate-classify opening the gate for a subagent: classifyIntent returns before any state read when isChildSession is true
mcp-route-guard running on every pre_tool call: coreToolNameFor returns null for a non-MCP name
post-edit-quality command injection through an edited file's path: the router spawns without a shell
